## What's Changed
* Harden bootstrap identity and failure analysis by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/126
* Publish CLI coverage through Codecov by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/130
* chore: point The Bushido Collective links at withbushido.ai by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/119
* Fix website deployment build runtime by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/131
* feat(patterns): add kanban task-management plugin (YYLO Ledger skill) by @InsightFactoryAPP in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/117

## New Contributors
* @InsightFactoryAPP made their first contribution in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/117

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/compare/v3.21.6...v3.22.0

## What's Changed
* Stabilize hook test UI render assertions by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/129


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/compare/v3.21.5...v3.21.6

## What's Changed
* Respect OMP-managed agent workspaces by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/118
* fix(website): clear Biome lint errors blocking the validate gate by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/120
* ops: capture a replacement Railway token into Terraform Cloud without printing it by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/122
* Stage guarded Han bootstrap by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/124
* Bind Han bootstrap to one unattended execution by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/125
* Fix Stop hook project discovery and validation by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/127
* fix(plugins): rename reserved plugin names and migrate installs by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/121


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/compare/v3.21.4...v3.21.5

## What's Changed
* fix(coordinator): stop the spawn storm burning CPU by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/115


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/compare/v3.21.3...v3.21.4

## What's Changed
* fix(browse): stop the hosted dashboard blaming the coordinator by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/113
* feat(reddit)!: point the plugin at the hosted authenticated MCP server by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/108
* fix(plugins): remove Reddit from the public marketplace by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/114
* fix(han): sanitize Windows project path slugs by @patrickswedish in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/105

## New Contributors
* @patrickswedish made their first contribution in https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/pull/105

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TheBushidoCollective/han/compare/v3.21.2...v3.21.3
